# How English words stem: "word -> stem", then words that must meet ("a = b") and must not ("a != b").
# Both sides of a term are stemmed alike, so a stem need not be a word.

pedals -> pedal
pedal -> pedal
studies -> study
studied -> study
boxes -> box
switches -> switch
classes -> class
buses -> bus
bus -> bus
axis -> axis
status -> status
stopped -> stop
stopping -> stop
called -> call
adding -> add
brake -> brak
braked -> brak
braking -> brak
brakes -> brak
driver's -> driver
need -> need
has -> has
ECUs -> ECU
ECU -> ECU
ABS -> ABS
Pedal -> pedal

brake pedal = brake pedals
Brake Pedal = brake pedal
driver's seat = drivers seat
switch = switches
stop = stopped
study = studies
control unit = control units
ECU = ECUs

ABS != abs
series != sery
bus != bu
stop != step
